name: Heir Apparent
source:
A young man begins his journey on a summer vacation with the people closest to him. Oblivious to the turmoil that is about to strike the capital and spread like wildfire to the rest of the country.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/SilkandMilkProductions]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一个年轻人在暑假与最亲近的人开始了他的旅程。他们没有注意到即将袭击首都并像野火一样蔓延到全国其他地区的骚乱。

[编辑自[url=https://www.patreon.com/SilkandMilkProductions]Patreon[/url]]
